rows.title: Three Monkeys
rows.comment: but what’s remarkable about his fifth feature
rows.verdict_le10: but what’s remarkable about his fifth feature
rows.dek_lead: Whether Ceylan speaks of or for Turkey is open for debate, but what’s remarkable about his fifth feature, Three Monkeys, is how he stamps a fairly straightforward genre piece with the marks of his own artistry.
